training_data_type: REAL measured plant telemetry (not synthetic) — Kaggle "Solar Power Generation Data" (anikannal), two real Indian solar plants, inverter-level generation + plant-level weather sensors, joined on timestamp
known_limitation: Only 34 days of data from 2 plants (one geographic region/climate) — real telemetry, but a narrow sample. Predictions for sites in very different climates than these two Indian plants should be treated with appropriate caution.
